items.title: Customer Portal Initiative
items.description: Establish a modern customer portal to improve customer experience and reduce manual operational overhead.

quotes.quote: We are looking at building a customer portal and I would like a proposal for our board meeting.

items.title: Reduce Operations Workload
items.description: Minimize the time the operations team spends manually answering tracking and invoice queries.

quotes.quote: Our customers ring or email us constantly asking two things: where is my shipment, and can you send me a copy of that invoice. It takes up a lot of the operations team's day and it makes us look dated next to the bigger players.

items.title: Operations Team
items.description: Internal staff members who currently handle high volumes of manual customer inquiries.

quotes.quote: It takes up a lot of the operations team's day and it makes us look dated next to the bigger players.

items.title: Customers
items.description: External clients who require access to shipment tracking, invoices, and online services.

quotes.quote: Customers log in, see their shipments, see where they are, download invoices and maybe pay them.

items.title: Shipment Tracking View
items.description: Allow logged-in customers to view their active shipments and their current locations.

quotes.quote: Customers log in, see their shipments, see where they are, download invoices and maybe pay them.

items.title: Invoice Download
items.description: Enable customers to view and download copies of their invoices directly from the portal.

quotes.quote: Customers log in, see their shipments, see where they are, download invoices and maybe pay them.

items.title: Online Invoice Payment
items.description: Provide customers with the option to pay their invoices online through the portal.

quotes.quote: Customers log in, see their shipments, see where they are, download invoices and maybe pay them.

items.title: Mobile Responsiveness
items.description: The portal must feature a clean, modern user interface optimized for mobile devices.

quotes.quote: Something clean and modern that works on a phone.

items.title: Transportation Management System (TMS)
items.description: The existing internal system containing all shipment and tracking data.

quotes.quote: Tracking needs to come out of our TMS. That is where all the shipment data lives.

items.title: TMS Tracking Integration
items.description: Integrate the portal with the TMS to retrieve real-time shipment tracking details.

quotes.quote: Tracking needs to come out of our TMS. That is where all the shipment data lives.

items.title: Finance System Invoice Integration
items.description: Integrate the portal with the finance system to retrieve invoice documents.

quotes.quote: Invoices as well, though I think those sit somewhere else, I would need to check with finance.

items.title: Online Shipment Queries
items.description: Allow customers to submit support queries regarding specific shipments directly within the portal.

quotes.quote: 3. It would be good if customers could raise a query on a shipment rather than emailing us.

items.title: Online Collection Booking
items.description: Allow customers to book cargo collections online through the portal.

quotes.quote: 4. Some of our bigger customers have asked for a way to book a collection online. I do not know if that is phase one or later.

items.title: Monthly Volume Reporting
items.description: Provide customers with monthly summaries of their shipment volumes.

quotes.quote: 5. Reporting would be nice. A couple of customers have asked for monthly volume summaries.

items.title: IT Manager
items.description: Bill, the IT Manager, who manages the TMS and network infrastructure.

quotes.quote: We do have an IT manager, Bill, who looks after the TMS and our network. He can answer the detailed questions, but he is on holiday until the end of the month.

items.title: IT Manager Availability
items.description: Detailed technical questions regarding TMS and network integration depend on the IT Manager returning from holiday.

quotes.quote: He can answer the detailed questions, but he is on holiday until the end of the month.

items.title: Quarterly Board Meeting Timeline
items.description: The proposal and cost estimates are required for presentation at the upcoming quarterly board meeting.

quotes.quote: On timing, the board meets quarterly and I would like to put something in front of them. Sooner is better but I would not say we have a hard date.
